name: hou_mcp_asset_download
description: Megascans asset downloader with checksum validation and retry. Actions: download, verify, register. Only downloads assets selected by semantic intelligence layers. Requires VIBRANTE_MEGASCANS_TOKEN.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.acquisition_online import get_megascans_downloader

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Download(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_download"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",            "string", widget_type="text", default="download")
        self.add_input("asset_id",          "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("provider",          "string", widget_type="text", default="megascans")
        self.add_input("dest_dir",          "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("download_url",      "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("quality",           "string", widget_type="text", default="medium")
        self.add_input("expected_checksum", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("local_path",        "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_output("local_path",       "string")
        self.add_output("checksum",         "string")
        self.add_output("bytes_downloaded", "int")
        self.add_output("verified",         "bool")
        self.add_output("result",           "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action   = str(inputs.get("action") or "download").strip().lower()
        asset_id = str(inputs.get("asset_id") or "").strip()
        dest_dir = str(inputs.get("dest_dir") or "").strip()
        dl_url   = str(inputs.get("download_url") or "").strip()
        quality  = str(inputs.get("quality") or "medium").strip()
        expected = str(inputs.get("expected_checksum") or "").strip()
        lpath    = str(inputs.get("local_path") or "").strip()
        provider = str(inputs.get("provider") or "megascans").strip()
        try:
            dl = get_megascans_downloader()
            if action == "verify":
                res = dl.verify_download(lpath, expected)
                return {"local_path": lpath, "checksum": "", "bytes_downloaded": 0, "verified": bool(res.get("verified")), "result": res, "exec_out": True}
            elif action == "register":
                res = dl.register_download(asset_id, lpath, provider=provider, checksum=expected)
                return {"local_path": lpath, "checksum": expected, "bytes_downloaded": 0, "verified": False, "result": res, "exec_out": True}
            else:
                r = dl.download_asset(asset_id, dest_dir, download_url=dl_url, quality=quality, expected_checksum=expected)
                return {"local_path": r.local_path, "checksum": r.checksum, "bytes_downloaded": r.bytes_downloaded, "verified": r.ok, "result": r.to_dict(), "exec_out": True}
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_asset_download failed: {e}")
            return {"local_path": "", "checksum": "", "bytes_downloaded": 0, "verified": False, "result": {}, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Download
